info.title: Bigtincan Hub Public API
info.description: The Bigtincan Hub Public API provides programmatic access to the Bigtincan sales enablement platform: stories, files, channels, tabs, groups, users, tags, bookmarks, forms, public file shares, search, CRM story recommendations, interaction tracking and admin management.

oauth2_password.description: Client ID + Client Secret + API Key exchanged at /services/oauth2/token with grant_type=password. Returns access_token + refresh_token. The As-User header is available only with this flow. Source: https://pubapi.bigtincan.com/doc/interactive/

oauth2_authorization_code.description: Interactive Bigtincan Hub user login. The As-User header is disabled for this flow. Source: https://pubapi.bigtincan.com/doc/interactive/

get.description:
Story CRM recommendations are based on the provided keywords and CRM metadata set on stories.

    Files will be returned based on the provided keywords.
    Stories will be returned based on CRM metadata. If no results are found via metadata then stories will be returned based on the provided keywords.

parameters.name: crm_products
parameters.description: JSON array of strings of CRM product names

get.description:
DEPRECATED: use /search/stories instead. Search for stories.

    Generic Search (For example find all documents with term 'test')
    Send 'test' as the keyword.

    Search Types
    - Stories returns stories.
    - Files returns files.
    - Tags returns stories and files with the requested tag.

    You can search in following sections. Fields for each search type will be as follows:
    Stories - title, description
    Files - filename, content, extension
    Comments - comment, user
    Meetings - title, description
    People - firstname, lastname, email, jobtitle, skill
    Tags - tagNotes - title,content

    Examples:
    Request format for searching text 'test' only in story title - fields[0]=title or you can even send fields=title if
    there is only one field Request format for searching text 'test' in both story title and description -
    fields[0]=title, fields[1]=description Fields depend on type selected

    Filters
    The following aggregation filters are provided:
    tab, channel, author, range and (tag - for stories or mime - for files)

    The search result contains aggregated results with id, term and count which can be used to narrow down searchresults

    Example:
    To filter search results by specific tabs:
    Keyword: test
    Filters would contain the JSON object:
    {'tab_id':['dbAUxa', 'sFicvuF']}

    If you want to drill down further by channel and author:

    Filters would contain the JSON object:
    {'tab_id':['dbAUxa', 'sFicvuF'], 'channel_id':['cuydsy', 'dsoivwP], 'author_id':['XMudha'], 'range':[{'unit':'months','value':1}]}

    Date Filter
    You can specify three units - days, weeks and months.

    Example:
    Last Month - date filter to be used for last month is [{'unit':'months','value':1}]
    Last Week - [{'unit':'weeks','value':1}]
    Last 24 Hours - [{'unit':'days','value':1}]
    Last 6 Months - [{'unit':'months', 'value':6}]

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: JSON object of Fields within search type

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON object with array of IDs - List of possible filters are described above

parameters.description: Exclude internal files like btc, btcf, btca, btce

post.summary: Upload a file to attach to a new or existing story.
post.description:
Upload a file to attach to a new or existing story.

    Upon success an array of objects will be returned with the following keys: filename, description, category, size

    Upon failure an array of objects will be returned with the following keys: code, message, filename

    The order in which files were uploaded is maintained when output is returned.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword or phrase to search by. Enclose in double quotes for exact matching. Supports asterisks for wildcards.

parameters.name: q_mode
parameters.description: If `SimpleSearchWithAdvancedFilters` is enabled, this field can be set to `Advanced`, `Simple`, or `null`. If `SimpleSearchWithAdvancedFilters` is disabled, `Search` is always set to `Advanced` regardless of the value of this field.

parameters.name: reporting_category
parameters.description: The value for the `reporting_category` field will be one of analytics_and_recent, only_analytics, or dont_record. If this field is set to null, the default reporting category is set to `analytics_and_recent`. If this field is set to `dont_record`, the search history will not be recorded. If the `q` parameter is empty, the search history will be recorded as only_analytics.

put.description:
Update a story.

    How to edit files
    You can use either of following ways to edit files and you cannot mix both ways together:
    1. files/new_files
    files: the existing files you want to keep, [] means removing all existing files
    new_files: the new files you want to add

    2. append_files/remove_files
    append_files: files you want to append/add
    remove_files: files you want to remove from the existing files

    Sharing bitmask:
    The field 'sharing_bitmask' is a combination of the following bits:
    - No sharing: 0
    - Device sharing: 1
    - Share with Audit: 2
